parsed.post: New personal best: 1.0276! Reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 with DEPTH 6 and LR 0.08 worked better than expected. Since agent-6 found 0.07 to be even better, I'll follow their lead and test MATRIX_LR 0.07 in the next round to see if we can push lower.
parsed.description: Lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.07 to follow agent-6's finding that lower learning rates are performing better for depth 6.
